summary: Backend-only test of MediaHunt FastAPI. Ran pytest suite (14 tests) and direct curl validation against external REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. 13/14 pytest passed (92.8%). All requested curl endpoints behaved correctly except /api/settings/test-connection?api_key=<invalid> which incorrectly returns success=true. Settings deep-merge + disk persistence on /app/data/config.json verified; OpenSubtitles key reset to empty after test as required.

critical.issue: Returns 200 {"success": true, "message": "Conexão estabelecida com OpenSubtitles."} for an obviously invalid key (e.g. 'invalid_dummy_xyz'). Root cause: server.py line 481 calls https://api.opensubtitles.com/api/v1/infos/languages, which is a PUBLIC endpoint that returns 200 even with no/garbage Api-Key header (verified via curl directly). Result: the UI 'Test connection' button will always say success regardless of what the user types, defeating the purpose of the validation. Fix: switch to an authenticated endpoint that requires a valid Api-Key, e.g. https://api.opensubtitles.com/api/v1/user (returns 401 on invalid key) or send a HEAD/GET to /subtitles?query=test which requires auth. Then return success=False on any non-2xx.

action_items: Fix /api/settings/test-connection so invalid OpenSubtitles keys return success=false. Use an authenticated endpoint (e.g. /api/v1/user) instead of the public /api/v1/infos/languages.
After the fix, re-run the existing pytest test_test_connection_invalid_key — no new test code needed.

rca of the issue: RCA — /api/settings/test-connection: the implementation calls GET https://api.opensubtitles.com/api/v1/infos/languages with the user's Api-Key header. That endpoint is public (returns 200 with no/invalid key — confirmed by direct curl: bad-key:200, no-key:200). Therefore the only way the current code returns success=false is if the network is down or OpenSubtitles is offline. To actually validate the key, hit an endpoint that requires authentication (e.g. /api/v1/user returns 401 on bad key) and report success only on 2xx. Reproduction: curl '$BASE/api/settings/test-connection?api_key=anything' → 200 success=true.
